<!-- pr-reviewer: 4ac8a800e015623665f10cb576a989f18df51199 -->

**Needs changes before merge** — the PR conflicts with the current side branch, and merging it as-is would leave the side branch in a non-compiling state.

What looks good
- Stage 1 is honest and small: one `region()` builder, one checked `PlanarRegion::new`, one adapter, and the refusals are proven by law pins. The region law pins pin law 2 (no start side, in the type system) and law 1 (one selection, one region, any pick order and direction).
- The two disagreements with the present paths (the Offset band at the stock edge, the sliver drop) are pinned by name, with decision-record entries and the maintainer's Outside-to-the-edge call recorded in decision 4.
- No `unwrap()`/`expect()`/`panic!` outside tests; each new file stays under 400 lines; each new module carries a provenance line; no process file, no new dependency, no `.github`, no `Cargo.toml`, no snapshot PNGs.
- Provenance, refusal names and the decision record match the code. The two law-suite pins of this PR pass on the head here (8/8 region laws, 5/5 motion pins), and the light lane is green on the head.

Results (trial merge with `origin/side/path-kernel` at `73dc7cb6f`: CONFLICT in `crates/pathkernel/tests/laws.rs`)
- The base moved since the PR was cut: the law suite (#4175) and the law measures (#4167) merged into the side branch. The merge conflicts on the directory suite mod list and the doc comment. Conflict text:
  ```
  Auto-merging crates/pathkernel/tests/laws.rs
  CONFLICT (content): Merge conflict in crates/pathkernel/tests/laws.rs
  Automatic merge failed; fix conflicts and then commit the result.
  ```
- The trial merge was aborted right after it produced the conflict; the worktree is back to clean head `4ac8a800e`. Nothing is committed.
- Linux, local worktree `cc-pr4181-review`, head `4ac8a800e`.
- `cargo test -p camcraft-pathkernel --test laws region::`: 8 passed, 0 failed.
- `cargo test -p camcraft-motion --lib -- kernel_region`: 5 passed, 0 failed.
- `cargo clippy -p camcraft-pathkernel -p camcraft-motion --all-targets -- -D warnings`: clean.
- Light lane `cargo xtask gate light` (on the head): 6 of 6 steps green, wall 1.5 min (light build 4s, motion lib 12s, adaptive_troch_island 43s, adaptive_troch_neck 17s, adaptive_troch_parallel 11s, app pocket_pass_start 2s).
- Example catalog suites: not run — no post or toolpath change in this diff. The PR body names `example_catalog`, `example_catalog_adaptive` and `example_catalog_edge_work` as green on the head.
- Targeted heavy step: not owed — this is a P2 PR, not a safety-floor P1 change.

Requested before merge
1. Refresh the branch against the updated side branch: `git merge origin/side/path-kernel` (now `73dc7cb6f`), and resolve `crates/pathkernel/tests/laws.rs`. Keep both sides' added lines: the base's doc comment and mod list (`kit`, `grid`, `l1_guide` .. `l7_move`, `link_rule`, `registry`, `standins`) plus this PR's `region` module, and keep the gate-map entry for `region_build`, `region_check` and `selection`. Do not resolve the conflict by deleting either side.
2. Fix the two law-suite callers of the old `PlanarRegion::new` signature that the base added — `kit.rs:207` (`rebuild`) and `standins.rs:57` (`pocket_region`). The PR changes the signature to take `plane` first; the PR fixes its own `construction.rs:97` call, but the two base callers still pass the 7-argument form. The merged tree must carry those fixes (or the body must record them as the merge-time fix, as the #4175 review flagged), and the merged tree must build before the PR merges.
3. Re-run the quick gate and clippy on the refreshed head before the PR merges, and re-run the light lane if the refresh touches motion or pathkernel code (the head's green light lane will be stale after the refresh).

Questions / notes
- `NOT_ORIENTED` has no negative test by construction (camcraft-geometry gives only normalized regions); this is recorded honestly in the body, so no change asked. Worth a line in the K7 law-suite record.
- `the_region_stage_takes_no_start_side` pins the type of `region`, but the `plane` parameter is carried, not read, by `region()`; law 9 reads as "the region holds its plane", which is fine to keep, but worth a line in the decision record saying the plane is provenance for K1.
- The PR body's quick-gate result (184 steps on the final head `4ac8a800e`) will be stale after the refresh; a fresh run is step 3 above.

A maintainer will approve and merge by hand.

<!-- pr-reviewer: e83a3107600f49f9e559521008451d6928a06825 -->

**Ready for the maintainer to merge** — the head moved to `e83a31076` (a merge of `origin/side/path-kernel` at `73dc7cb6f`), and the refresh is clean. This review is a delta on the refresh, not on the old `4ac8a800e` head, which this supersedes.

Delta review of the refresh
- The two hand edits match the two findings of the first review round, and only those: `kit.rs:207` passes `p.plane()` as the new first argument of `PlanarRegion::new`, and `standins.rs:59` walls the pocket region with the boundary loops of the cutter-centre area (the same shape as the real builder, which classifies the centre loops into walls and the stock edge). `laws.rs` keeps both sides' lines: the base's doc comment and mod list, plus this PR's `region` module and gate-map entry.
- No other hand edits: every other change is the base's own new law-suite and law-measure files (#4175, #4167), which were reviewed against the base. Every remaining `PlanarRegion::new` caller in the merged tree passes the plane (region_build, construction, kit, standins, region).

Results on the new head (Linux, local worktree `cc-pr4181-review`, target built fresh with `sccache` — the old target was corrupt and had to be removed)
- `cargo test -p camcraft-pathkernel --test laws`: 72 passed, 0 failed (8 region tests + 64 law tests of the base suite)
- `cargo test -p camcraft-motion --lib -- kernel_region`: 5 passed, 0 failed
- `cargo clippy -p camcraft-pathkernel -p camcraft-motion --all-targets -- -D warnings`: clean
- `cargo xtask gate light`: 7 steps, 0 failed, wall 7.3 min (light build 236s, motion lib 44s, adaptive_troch_island 25s, adaptive_troch_neck 17s, adaptive_troch_parallel 11s, pocket_pass_start 3s, offset_pass_start 53s). The `offset_pass_start` light step is new in this head (law measures, #4167).
- No example-catalog or post/toolpath step: this diff is a new kernel stage and its pins, not a post or a toolpath. The author's body reports the example_catalog suites green on this head; not re-run here.
- Targeted heavy step: not owed — this is a P2 PR, not a safety-floor change.

Trial merge: the `laws.rs` conflict is resolved by the merge itself; `mergeable` is `MERGEABLE` at the head (`e83a31076`). The two hunks are checked above. No local conflict to resolve.

Questions / notes (non-blocking)
- `NOT_ORIENTED` still has no negative test by construction (`camcraft-geometry` gives only normalized regions); this is recorded in the body.
- The refresh changed only test files, so the light lane and the quick-gate numbers in the body still hold by content; the light lane is re-run here anyway.

A maintainer will approve and merge by hand.
